findings.title: Independent dice lack distinguishable accessible component names
reproduce: Render a known independent tag mb.holding with values[[1],[1]] and resolved texts Темный / Турели.
Inspect the two button accessible names in Russian (keyboard focus or accessibility tree).
findings.expected: Each accessible name identifies its component purpose and current result, as required by TAGS§4.10; distinguish the first/style and second/form dice even when both roll the same value. Apply consistently to independent tags and both locales.
findings.impact: A screen-reader user cannot determine which component will be rerolled. Equal values are normal valid outcomes, so this affects ordinary supported states.
findings.evidence: Independently transpiled real TagRow.tsx and rendered with react-dom/server; both actual aria-label values were identical. SVG is aria-hidden. This is not an inference from developer tests.
findings.fix_scope: Change invisible accessible naming only; retain cube sizes, typography, spacing and existing rows. Include localized component purpose and displayed result/override; keep product pair behavior intact.
findings.recheck: Focused component/accessibility check for equal independent dice values in RU/EN, plus existing required checks on the new SHA. No requirement to add a broad new browser scenario.

scope: Fix invisible accessible dice purposes/results only; no visible UI expansion. Preserve approved product scope.
